Type.evidence_source: [page/8/Text/2] … I am angry with God. It's like I am angry with God … at times you go to church and get all the encouragement and you ask God to give you something that will bring you some peace within your heart and I don't get it … (woman 6)

Area.evidence_source: [page/7/Text/10] They were angry because of disappointment in their faith/God. Some could not understand why God allowed suffering in their lives. Knowing and believing that God is supreme and can solve problems, they wondered why he did not save them from the challenges they were going through.
